Founder & Managing Director’s Message
EKCHAKRA GROUP is an inspired synthesis of dynamic modern enterprise and decades of seasoned industry wisdom. This equilibrium empowers our group to scale sustainably across both Indian domestic markets and high-growth international trade corridors. Our foundational objective is to engineer a resilient, end-to-end global supply chain and establish high-trust Indian branding accessible worldwide. It is an ambitious journey, and I am confident that our agile leadership team, our world-class vendors, and our cherished global clientele are ready to achieve extraordinary milestones. We continually invite breakthrough innovations, new product lines, and value-accretive partnerships. Together, we build a smarter, sustainable, and interconnected world.

SOLARFlagship PV Tech

TOPCon N-Type Solar PV Modules (500Wp – 640Wp+)

Next-generation N-Type Tunnel Oxide Passivated Contact solar panels delivering up to 23.32% efficiency and 30-year warranty.

Efficiency exceeding 22.0% up to 23.32%
Power output ranges from 500Wp to 640Wp+ (commercial/utility) and 275W (compact)
SOLARUtility Grade

High-Efficiency Grid-Tie Solar Inverter

Transformerless solar inverters with 98%+ conversion efficiency, multi-MPPT tracking, and net metering synchronization.

Up to 98.6% conversion efficiency with dual/quad MPPT algorithms
Anti-Islanding auto-shutdown protecting utility line maintenance workers
SOLARBest Seller

Smart All-in-One Hybrid Solar Inverter (3kW – 50kW)

Integrated solar inverter and battery charge management unit with sub-10ms UPS switching and smart peak shaving.

All-in-One Multi-Mode design with integrated MPPT charge controller
Fast-switching UPS grade backup (<10ms) for critical servers and sensitive appliances
SOLARHeavy Duty

Heavy-Duty Pure Sine Wave Off-Grid Inverter

Standalone solar inverter systems (1kW to 10kW+) engineered for remote sites, farms, and independent micro-grids.

Pure sine wave output with minimal total harmonic distortion (THD < 3%)
Wide MPPT voltage range with up to 98% tracking efficiency
SOLAR5000+ Cycles

LiFePO4 Lithium Iron Phosphate Energy Storage (48V / 100Ah – 200Ah)

Ultra-safe, long-cycle life lithium storage blocks delivering 5,000+ cycles at 80% DoD and 95% round-trip efficiency.

5,000+ cycles at 80% Depth of Discharge (DoD)
95%+ round-trip coulombic efficiency with fast 1C charging support

Corporate Social Responsibility & Impact

Empowering Communities & Ecological Stewardship

At EKCHAKRA, business expansion is inseparably bound to sustainable development, clean energy access, and rural upliftment.

Solar Power for Rural Schools & Clinics

Under our renewable mission, Ekchakra equips remote rural schools and primary health centers with subsidized solar micro-grids and LiFePO4 battery storage, ensuring uninterrupted clean lighting and digital learning.

120+ Village Centers Electrified

Farmer Empowerment & Organic Bio-Compost

We train marginal dairy and agricultural farmers in processing cow dung into high-grade 3-2-1 NPK bio-compost, improving soil health while creating supplementary rural household income.

2,500+ Farmers Upskilled

Artisan Heritage Revival & Fair-Trade Wages

Through Shilp Craft, we connect traditional brass and wood artisans directly with international consumer markets, eliminating middlemen and providing fair, dignified livelihood stability.

450+ Artisan Families Supported

Skill Development & Women’s Garment Training

Delight Apparel runs dedicated vocational training workshops in apparel stitching, quality inspection, and pattern making, enabling financial independence for rural women.

800+ Certified Women Trainees
